## ee6ef749efca

**Classification: reproduced task-test portability defect; no generator failure found in a finite draw probe.** The required isolated task-test command returned exit 1 with 17 passed cases (9 tests plus 8 subtests) and 9 setup errors. Every error is `FileNotFoundError` for a hard-coded guessed path ending in `generators/ee6ef749efca/data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl`; the portable runtime intentionally does not place canonical data there. The tests should use `reviewer_support.canonical_pairs` and `reviewer_support.find_root` rather than derive a data path from source depth. Evidence: `checks/audit/ee6ef749efca/task-tests/result.json` and its JUnit/progress files.

Separately, I generated 900 scenes (`seed 0..299` in each of easy/medium/hard). I observed 0 self-check failures, 0 determinism failures, and 736 unique normalized inputs; profile/decoy counts are in `checks/audit/ee6ef749efca/audit_probe.json`. That finite check does not enumerate every override cross-product or plausible semantic rival, so it supports only “no generator failure found in this probe,” not a clean universal audit. I did not modify this audit target.
